reason: The kitchen is run by my helper and the family WhatsApp list already works. I would not add an app to that, and I am not going to photograph receipts every week.
objection: My helper manages the kitchen, not an app. Getting her and my spouse to move off WhatsApp onto something new is the real problem, and I would be the one doing all the scanning.
would_change_my_mind: If my helper could use it easily in Arabic and the shared list worked right from WhatsApp, so nobody has to change how the household already does things.
